summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of the bilingual AI Platform completed. All 12 review request scenarios verified against the real preview URL with real LLM/Nano-Banana calls. 19/20 backend pytest cases passed (1 intentional skip for credit-drain to save cost); the 20th was a code-review-only guarantee. Every frontend flow (register, login, chat, text, image, history, settings, upgrade, language switcher, admin login) worked. AI feature verdicts (skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm, ai-testing-image-video): chat - pass - reply '43' to '17+26=?', credits 100->99; text/generate - pass - real article/rewrite/summarize output, credits ->98; image/generate - pass - real base64 JPEG data-URL, natural width 1408 in rendered , credits -5. No mocked outputs, no silent fallbacks (backend logs confirm live LiteLLM calls to gpt-5.6-terra and gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY).
ai_feature_verdicts: chat send (primary) - pass - reply '43' contained expected arithmetic answer; sidebar credits 100->99 in UI; skill: ai-testing-llm
text generate article/summarize - pass - on-topic prose returned via UI + backend; credits decremented by 1 in both cases; skill: ai-testing-llm
image generate (Nano Banana) - pass - data:image/jpeg;base64,... with natural width 1408, base64 bytes > 500, JPEG magic FFD8FF; credits decremented by 5; skill: ai-testing-image-video

minor.issue: Under 2 concurrent worker load (pytest-xdist default), LiteLLM/OpenAI upstream returned transient 502s after retries. In serial mode all pass. Not a functional bug but the app has no concurrency queue/retry-with-backoff at the API layer, so real users hammering the endpoint may occasionally see AI error 502.

ui_bugs.issue: Two elements share data-testid='language-switcher-toggle' (mobile header + desktop header). On desktop the mobile one is hidden but still first in the DOM, making generic Playwright selectors click a hidden element. Testability concern.

design_issues.screen: DashboardHome stat cards (Arabic RTL initial load)
issues: Card label text color (#64748B on #0C0C14) is quite dim; borderline WCAG AA. English view is clearer. Consider bumping label color to #94A3B8 for contrast.

action_items: Consider dedup / suffixing the language-switcher-toggle data-testid (e.g., -desktop / -mobile) so tests can target the visible one deterministically.
Optional: add a small retry/backoff around emergentintegrations LlmChat calls, or return 429 with a friendlier message when upstream retries fail.
Optional (design): lighten stat-card label color for better contrast in Arabic RTL default theme.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py leaks two subtle behaviors worth double-checking: chat 'send_chat' catches all exceptions and refunds credits, but does not refund on 'session not found' path - user has to be logged in and pay credits first, so no refund needed; ordering is correct.
spend_credits refunds are performed only when the LLM call itself throws; if the API-level HTTPException is raised later (e.g., empty image list) the code correctly refunds - good.
get_current_user re-queries the user on every request (extra DB call). For hot paths (chat streaming style) consider caching or trusting JWT claims.
CORS uses allow_credentials=True with an explicit origin (FRONTEND_URL) - correct pattern.
Cookies are set with secure=True and samesite='none' - correct for the preview HTTPS origin; would break on plain HTTP local dev.
Chat title truncation uses body.message[:40] before it is stored; fine.
No rate limiting on any endpoint - fine for MVP but could be noted.
